title: Steve Jobs
summary: Born in San Francisco on 24 February 1955 and raised around Cupertino, Jobs founded Apple Computer with Steve Wozniak in 1976, in his parents' garage in Los Altos. He was instrumental in the Macintosh, and as Apple's chief executive oversaw the iPod (2001), iPhone (2007) and iPad (2010). He resigned as CEO on 24 August 2011 and died at his Palo Alto home on 5 October 2011.
